nodes.label: Age Structure of India
nodes.subject: geography
nodes.detail: 0-14 years: 29%, 15-64 years: 64%, 65+: 7%. Large young population means growing labour force. Declining dependency ratio. Demographic dividend opportunity. But needs investment in education and health.

nodes.label: Demographic Dividend
nodes.subject: geography
nodes.detail: Economic growth potential from large proportion of working-age population (15-64 years). India has window of opportunity. Requires investment in health, education and skill development to realize the benefit.
